title: Die Internuntiatur des Johann Rudolf Schmid zum Schwarzenhorn (1649): Reisebericht, Instruktionen, Korrespondenz, Berichte
author: Johann Georg Metzger and Johann Rudolf Schmid zum Schwarzenhorn
institution: Universität Salzburg (Arno Strohmeyer) and Zentrum für Informationsmodellierung, Universität Graz (Georg Vogeler); FWF project P30091-G28
notes: Edition of the diary (Reisebericht) of Johann Georg Metzger, who accompanied the imperial internuncio Schmid zum Schwarzenhorn to Constantinople from December 1648 to September 1649, together with the instruction and secondary instruction, 26 letters to Emperor Ferdinand III, a final report and a secret report, with registers and commentary. The TEI for each object is served at /o:dipko.<id>/TEI_SOURCE (travel diary: o:dipko.rb). The site states a project term of 2017-2021 and shows nothing newer, so it is listed as archived.
